besluite.fout: 'na onder' copies English 'towards below'; Afrikaans has the direction adverb 'ondertoe'.
besluite.rede: Same direction and same action, in the natural Afrikaans form; nothing protected is touched.
An adverbial phrase before the object is normal Afrikaans word order, so the original reads well and the proposal is a longer lateral move.
'lief wees vir' is stronger than 'hou van', so the theme sentence about 'iets' would say more than it did; the original is plain and correct.
